506: def get_ascend_arch_from_env():
507:     arch = os.getenv("TRITON_ASCEND_ARCH", "")
508:     if arch == "":
509:         # User does not set arch by ENV. Thus directly return.
510:         return arch
511:     # User sets arch by ENV. Thus we need to check if it is supported.
512:     valid_arch_list = [
513:         "Ascend910B1",
514:         "Ascend910B2",
515:         "Ascend910B3",
516:         "Ascend910B4",
517:         "Ascend910_9362",
518:         "Ascend910_9372",
519:         "Ascend910_9381",
520:         "Ascend910_9382",
521:         "Ascend910_9391",
522:         "Ascend910_9392",
523:         "Ascend310B1",
524:         "Ascend310B2",
525:         "Ascend310B3",
526:         "Ascend310B4",
527:         "Ascend910_9579",
528:         "Ascend910_9581",
529:         "Ascend910_9589",
530:         "Ascend910_9599",
531:     ]
532:     is_valid = arch in valid_arch_list
533:     if not is_valid:
534:         valid_arch_str = ", ".join(valid_arch_list)
535:         raise ValueError(f"TRITON_ASCEND_ARCH = {arch} is invalid!"
536:                          f"Candidates are [{valid_arch_str}]")
537:     return arch
